title: An extension of algebraic independence of special values for non-lacunary power series
summary: We study the algebraic independence of special values of power series $f(β^{-1})$, where $β$ is a fixed Pisot or Salem number. In particular, we consider the case where $f(X)=\sum_{n\geq 0} t(n) X^{w(n)}$ is not a lacunary series and is not assumed to satisfy any special functional equation, such as a Mahler-type functional equation. In our main results, we give a new criterion of the algebraic independence of three values.
